# PN & Co. International

> Independent international trading company based in the United Arab Emirates. It owns Hunridge, a premium apparel brand designed in Dubai, and offers fabric sourcing and consultation to apparel businesses.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.example.com/): Hunridge first, then fabric sourcing for businesses.
- [Hunridge](https://www.example.com/hunridge.html): The Hunridge story. Premium apparel focused on quality, founded in Dubai.
- [Fabric Sourcing](https://www.example.com/fabric-sourcing.html): Fabric sourcing and consultation for fashion brands, garment manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers and institutional buyers.
- [Fabric Library](https://www.example.com/fabric-library.html): Collections of fabrics for apparel: bamboo, rayon and fashion blends; nylon performance; polyester and technical stretch.
- [About](https://www.example.com/about.html): The company and how it works.
- [Contact](https://www.example.com/contact.html): Buyer enquiries, sourcing requests, partnerships and questions about Hunridge.

## Notes
Fabric specifications on the site are illustrative. Availability, minimum order quantities and pricing are confirmed on enquiry.
